the checks of each live run and the head of the target.

parameters.name: org
parameters.description: The slug of the organization.

parameters.name: run_id
parameters.description: The identifier of the run.

Accepted.description: A request that the queue does later: a submission reads the PR first.

AuditEntry.description: An action of an admin, or a change of a queue.

AuditPage.description: A page of the audit log, newest first.

ConfigCheck.description:
`GET /orgs/{org}/repos/{repo}/queues/{queue}/config-check`: the last
check of the configuration of the SCM; no finding means a sound
configuration.

checked_at.description:
When CIHub checked the configuration; `None` before the first check,
which comes within minutes of the creation of the queue.

Dependent.description: A live run whose predecessors hold a PR of this run.

ErrorCode.description: The machine code of an error.

Finding.description: A point of the configuration of the SCM that the queue needs.

Graph.description:
The merge graph: the live items, and the predecessors that their tests
merge before them.

runs.description: The last run of each live group, the oldest first.

target_head_sha.description:
The head of the target branch that the queue saw last; `None` before
the first.

GraphEdge.description: The test of `to` merges `from` before it.

GraphRun.description:
A run of the graph: the items that it tests, on top of their
predecessors.

attempt.description:
From 1; a run tested again within the failure budget has a higher
attempt.

author.description: The login of the author of the PR.

no_batch.description: The PR is tested alone, never in a batch.

position.description: The order in the queue; `None` before the admission.

run_id.description:
The last run of the group of the item: the run that tests it, or
that tested it last; `None` outside a group.

state_description.description:
The sentence of `state_reason`, in English, for a person; it can
change without notice, unlike `state_reason`.

submitted_by.description:
The login of the person who submitted the PR; `None` when CIHub or an
API token did.

title.description: The title at the last read of the PR; `None` before the first.

ItemCounts.description: The current items of a queue in each state that is not terminal.

ItemPage.description: A page of items, newest submission first.

next_cursor.description: The cursor of the next page; `None` on the last page.

Me.description:
`GET /me`: the user of a session of the dashboard, and the organizations
that they reach.

app_install_url.description:
The page of the SCM that installs the App on an account, or chooses
the repositories of its installation; `null` when the SCM did not
answer.

OrgQueue.description: A queue of the organization, with its counters.

failed_last_24h.description:
The current items that reached `failed` in the 24 hours before the
request.

last_merged_at.description: When the last current item reached `merged`; `None` if no item merged.

merged_last_24h.description:
The current items that reached `merged` in the 24 hours before the
request.

repo.description: The name of the repository of the queue, as the routes name it.

OrgQueueList.description: `GET /orgs/{org}/queues`: by repository name, then queue name.

OrgRole.description: An organization of the user, and the role of the user in it.

PrItem.description: `GET /orgs/{org}/repos/{repo}/queues/{queue}/prs/{number}`: the last item of the PR.

timeline.description: With `?include=timeline`: the events of the item, in their order.

PriorityInput.description: The priority of a submission: a name or a value from 0 to 255.

Queue.description: A queue of a target branch.

config_error.description:
Why the last file read is not valid; the queue keeps the last valid
one.

config_sha.description: The head of the target whose configuration file the queue read last.

has_config_file.description:
The target branch has a configuration file, valid or not; without
it, the queue takes the defaults.

state_changed_at.description: When the queue reached its state; its creation before a first change.

state_changed_by.description:
The login of the person who asked for the state; `None` when CIHub
decided it, or when an API token asked for it.

strategy.description: The strategy of the last valid configuration file.

target_head_sha.description:
The head of the target branch that the queue saw last; `None` before
the first.

QueueAccess.description: Whether CIHub reaches the repository of a queue on the SCM.

QueueDetail.description:
`GET /orgs/{org}/repos/{repo}/queues/{queue}`: a queue, its counters as
in [`OrgQueue`], its runs and the summary of its settings.

Repo.description: A repository that the token sees.

RunCheck.description: A check or a status observed on the test SHA of a run.

SettingsSummary.description:
The settings of a queue that its page shows, from its last valid
configuration file.

failure_budget_retries.description: How many times a run that fails is tested again before its PRs fail.

oneOf.description: The `priority_rules` of the file decide without it.

head_shas.description: The heads merged in order: the predecessors, then the members.

TimelineEvent.description: An event of the log of a queue.

Window.description: The speculation window: how many runs the queue keeps in progress.
